name: Avian Flu
overview: Scripture teaches that healing and restoration come from the Lord, as Jeremiah 17:14 expresses a confident plea for God's healing and salvation. Jesus empowered His followers to heal the sick and freely give what they had received, emphasizing the ministry of compassion and divine power (Matthew 10:8; Luke 9:2). The early church practiced prayer and anointing for the sick, demonstrating faith in God's healing through the community of believers (James 5:14). These verses affirm that physical healing, including in times of illness such as avian flu, is ultimately grounded in trusting God's grace and provision.
